mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `product` (name, description, price, stock, image, images, category_id, status, is_hot, is_new) VALUES (#{name}, #{description}, #{price}, #{stock}, #{image}, #{images}, #{categoryId}, COALESCE(#{status}, 1), COALESCE(#{isHot}, 0), COALESCE(#{isNew}, 0))
mapper.update: UPDATE `product` SET stock = stock + #{stock} WHERE id = #{id}
